items.title: Trump warns Taiwan against declaring independence, hours after summit with China's Xi
items.description: The US president says he wants Beijing and Taipei to "cool down" tensions over the self-governing island.

items.title: Trump and Xi conclude 'very successful' talks but few deals confirmed
items.description: There were plenty of choreographed ceremonies but no trade breakthroughs after the two-day visit.

items.title: Trump says 20-year nuclear programme suspension by Iran would be enough
items.description: The US president says Tehran has to show "real" commitment to removing nuclear fuel and stopping uranium enrichment.

items.title: Lebanon says six killed in Israeli strike as US announces ceasefire extension
items.description: President Trump announced the truce last month, but Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since then.

items.title: Prisoner swap goes ahead as Kyiv mourns 24 killed in Russian strike on flats
items.description: Among the victims in Kyiv was 12-year-old Lyubava Yakovleva, whose father was killed during the war.

items.title: AI vigilante trap snares alleged paedophile ex-teacher in France
items.description: The 66-year-old handed himself in after an influencer used AI to pose as a 14-year-old girl and broadcast their conversation online.

items.title: Judge declares another mistrial in Harvey Weinstein New York rape case
items.description: It marks the third time a New York jury has considered the case against the 74-year-old disgraced film mogul.

items.title: Israel says it has killed Hamas commander in Gaza air strike
items.description: Izz ad-Din al-Haddad, described as "one of the architects of the October 7 massacre", was killed in Gaza City, Israel says.

items.title: Five Italians die during cave scuba dive in Maldives
items.description: Four of the Italians were part of a team from the University of Genoa.

items.title: New York Times defends journalist after Israel threatens to sue
items.description: Israel's prime minister says he has ordered legal action over an article which alleged Israeli security officials raped Palestinian detainees.

items.title: New outbreak of Ebola kills 65 in eastern DR Congo
items.description: Africa's top health agency says around 246 cases have been reported - a case has also been reported in Uganda.

items.title: CIA chief visits Cuba as energy crisis worsens
items.description: The reported visit to Havana came after the US renewed an offer of aid to ease the effects of its oil blockade.
